reviews.text: I visit occasionally. It's very comfortable and perfect for people with dogs.

My dog ​​was a little nervous about her first grooming session, but she seemed to relax completely thanks to the kind atmosphere of the shop and the groomer. She looked incredibly cute afterwards and was overjoyed with her goat's milk treat. I'm so happy to have such a wonderful shop in my neighborhood.

I received the shampoo course. 
I'm so glad that my dog's fluffy shape lasted so long ♡
I was also happy that I was able to take photos in the cute photo booth after the trimming ♡

Luck is shy around people and other dogs, but this time he seemed to open up to the groomer and become attached to her, which was unusual for him. There must have been something he sensed in his own way as a dog. So the whole process went smoothly and comfortably.

I had Leo trimmed the other day.
He looked so cute and came home in a good mood.
The groomer was a man, and he was very kind
and good at cutting his dog, and Leo seemed to really like him.
Due to time constraints, I wasn't able to use the cafe this time, but I definitely want to use it next time.

He's really good at grooming...!
He makes my dog ​​100 times cuter.
I highly recommend getting a haircut at Marutto!

I always have my dog ​​groomed by a male groomer 🐶 and my dog ​​absolutely loves him.

The cafe has a wide selection of drinks and menu items, and you can enjoy delicious set meals and desserts.

The photo booth also really shows how much effort they put into it. It's amazing.

I feel like this is a place that was created with warm consideration for both dogs and their owners.

I took my dog ​​to the groomer for the first time.

Since he's a senior dog, the grooming session was short, and the kind groomer made him look beautiful.

He seemed to like the treats the shop sold, which were given to us as a gift, so I think I'll buy some next time.
The mini dog run and lunch set were excellent! 😊😊😊 …
I enjoyed the meal with my dog ​​🐶😋 …

This was my first time using their services.
My 16-year-old senior dog hadn't been feeling well lately, so I was worried about leaving him for grooming.
They were very professional and gave him a quick and beautiful haircut, specializing in senior dogs.
It was his first time getting a shaved face.
The groomer was very kind, and my dog ​​seemed to like them and was quite affectionate.
It wasn't too stressful for him, and he was energetic when we got home.
I'll definitely use their services again.

[A Whole Dog]
Grooming ¥6,300
He came back looking adorable
The food was delicious and my dog ​​was groomed beautifully!
I got a really cute haircut! ✂︎

All the staff were so kind, and the homemade food was absolutely delicious! I requested grooming services, and the groomer listened carefully to my needs, so I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​there. I will definitely use their services again! Thank you so much!

This was our second time using their grooming service.

My dog ​​can wait while eating during the grooming session, and afterwards, we can share treats and play together.

Grooming, which used to be a disliked experience, seems to have become a fun place for her.

She always gets such a cute haircut, so I plan to continue using their services in the future.

It was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed, but they did a really nice and cute job! ✨The staff were also very kind, so I was able to leave him there with peace of mind. 
The photo space was also really cute! I'm looking forward to using it again ⭐︎⭐︎⭐︎

I was surprised at how expensive it was!

We went alone with one person and one dog,

and asked for the set menu, the dog menu,

and to use the dog run (photo spot).

I knew it was 300 yen to use the dog run, so I paid without thinking,

but later I found out it was 1000 yen for the dog run...

No explanation was given at the time of payment.

On top of that, there was a separate 100 yen entrance fee for dogs,

and even though I ordered a set meal,

they said there was a "one drink only" rule,

so I ended up ordering an additional drink.

I'm grateful that this is a restaurant that allows dogs, and it's nothing to complain about,

but I feel like prices are getting more and more expensive compared to before,

so I'm rating it this way.

If only they'd at least explain it at the register...

It was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed and using the cafe!
While I was waiting for my grooming session, I was able to use the cafe and relax while enjoying a rice ball set meal, cafe au lait, and cake!
The groomer and all the cafe staff were so kind to me that I could tell they really love dogs 😊
After the adorable cut, there was also a stylish photo spot, so I thought it was a really fun place!

It was great that we could wait at the cafe while our dog was being groomed. We didn't have time to use the photo spot, but we'd like to use it next time. Our dog seemed to really enjoy the goat's milk after grooming.
